systems.system: Pasaporte biométrico CEMAC (biometric capture at diplomatic missions, validation by CNEDOGE)
systems.owner: CNEDOGE, with the Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Cooperación Internacional y Diáspora
systems.tiers: six diplomatic representations operational for biometric capture as of May 2026; others hold machines pending installation, connection to the national system and training

note: Biometric passport issuance through diplomatic missions; nothing on civil registration.
